facts.value: Types 'Contemporary Expressionism' character-by-character with a vertical purple cursor bar

facts.value: Displays 'AI edit' dropdown containing 'Rewrite', 'Adjust tone', 'Reduce', and 'Extend'

facts.value: Prompt text 'Brutalist, concrete architectural structure in an Icelandic countryside' with a 'Generate' button

facts.subject: End slate
facts.value: Purple diamond logo centers on a black screen for the final 5 seconds (1:31 to 1:36)

motionPurpose: At 0:38, the canvas smoothly resizes into a mobile phone mockup to demonstrate responsive layout adaptation across screen sizes.

whatToSteal.technique: Inline AI context popover floating directly over highlighted body text to perform quick actions like Rewrite, Reduce, or Extend without shifting focus.

whatNotToSteal.why: Zooming out to an infinite black canvas with dozens of scattered documents can look chaotic and obscure the core linear editing workflow for target users.

notRun: Exact audio decibel levels for voiceover and background track
Precise screen frame rate during render transitions
